newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MACMED UPS STAKE IN ZIMBABWE MEDICAL FIRM.
newsitem.headline: MACMED UPS STAKE IN ZIMBABWE MEDICAL FIRM.

text.p: Macmed Health Care Ltd said on Wednesday it had increased its shareholding in Zimbabwean medical supplies business Iatric Surgical Supplies (Pvt) Ltd to 75 percent from 45 percent with effect from November 1.
The health provider also said in a statement Iatric would acquire Protea Medical Services (Pvt) Ltd (Zimbabwe).
"The purchase of Protea will add further critical mass to Iatric while complementing the group's existing range of products," Macmed said.
Macmed would remit Z$16 million (around 6.9 million rand) in cash which would be sufficient for Iatric to acquire the operating assets of Protea and eliminate all interest bearing debt in Iatric.
The 6.9 million rand required by Macmed would be funded by the issue of 2.875 million ordinary shares at 2.40 rand per ordinary share.
It said Protea would benefit due to improved pricing from Macmed's South African subsidiary Protea Medical Services (Pty) Ltd.
